method: Compile both lesson Python fences, extract and execute the scorer, and test a valid 15-row fixture plus malformed ID, invalid priority column, missing separator, and non-text complete payload. No provider or network calls. Production build generated 405 pages; Pagefind indexed 405 pages / 15,475 words. Inspected full-page light/dark renders at a 1300px viewport.

observations.trace: The former scorer accepted TC-01 extra because it matched a numeric prefix and could count invalid P0 text from the whole line. Exact ID and fourth-column checks now reject both; invalid completed payload types fail as score 0 without raising.

limitations: Synthetic rows verify the implemented grading predicates only; they do not establish that the rubric measures real task quality.
Historical per-run model responses and original scorer version remain unavailable, so the five-run historical result cannot be recomputed.
Visual checks establish the rendered page layout only; they do not validate historical model outputs, provider behavior, or production task quality.
